cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last in the race, first in route appreciation. Let's compare what we noticed; start with plants, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a speed contest. I got to the finish first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's one category. Count the plants you identified, not how fast you passed them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I named ten. You called every flower a daisy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I win for consistency. One label throughout; please use the same measure for both of us. How many times did you have to change yours?
